name: EXILED
description: Cast out from the upper towers, forging an original path. Distressed typography and fractured seals printed on heavyweight washed jersey.
storyQuote: They exiled the warrior. They will welcome back the legend.

name: LAST BLOOD
print: Screen Print with Blood-Red Metallic Accents
description: A crimson crescent seal burning against deep obsidian black. Designed for high impact with minimal chest emblem and monumental back illustration.
storyQuote: Not until the final drop of doubt has left the veins.

name: NO LIMIT
description: Kai’s relentless training tee. High-voltage stylized kinetic lines that embody the mindset of surpassing physical barriers.
storyQuote: Limits exist only for those who ask for permission to break them.

name: SHADOW CODE
description: Fictional warrior runes and shadowy ritual composition across a pure heavyweight cotton canvas.
storyQuote: Silence is the sharpest technique in the dark.

name: INNER BEAST
description: Full-back original manga illustration of the awakening beast spirit within. High-contrast monochromatic composition.
storyQuote: Do not tame the beast inside. Teach it who leads the battle.

name: 02:17 AM
description: Yuki’s iconic highway run tee. Reflective holographic inks and fictional digital timestamps evoking rain-slicked asphalt under neon towers.
storyQuote: The exact minute the city turns off its voice and turns on its soul.

name: NEON RONIN
print: High-Density Screen Print with UV Glow Effect
description: A cybernetic warrior slicing through digital encryption. Fictional city typography and high-density screen graphics.
storyQuote: In a city that never sleeps, the blade glows brightest at 3 AM.

name: MIDNIGHT RUN
description: Futuristic motorcycle blueprint overlay on the back with telemetry coordinates printed on the left chest.
storyQuote: Throttle wide open until the digital horizon dissolves.

name: TOKYO AFTER DARK
description: Cinematic rain-streaked alleyway perspective rendered in tonal greys with vibrant electric cyan accent kanji.
storyQuote: The rain washes the concrete, but it reflects every dream.

name: GHOST PROTOCOL
description: Binary protocols and encrypted firewalls forming an enigmatic cyber skull visage across the reverse panel.
storyQuote: Leave no digital footprints. Become the signal.

name: NEON SOUL
description: Vibrant dual-tone laser wave composition with futuristic circuit motifs on the upper right sleeve.
storyQuote: A synthetic pulse beats louder when you walk your own road.

name: PLAYER 01
print: Vintage Pixel Soft Ink & Scanline Texture
description: CRT monitor scanlines and memory card save-screen typography. Built for those who lived the golden era of arcade nostalgia.
storyQuote: Insert coin to continue living between imagination and reality.

name: SAVE POINT
print: Soft Touch Screen Print with Glow Accent
description: A glowing save crystal rendered in subtle 90s anime vector geometry with checkpoint coordinates.
storyQuote: Rest here. The hardest dungeons are still ahead.

name: DIGITAL HEART
description: Liquid chrome Y2K typography wrapping around a cyber heart graphic with Japanese glitch subtitles.
storyQuote: Pumping pure imagination through dial-up wires.

name: DEAD INTERNET CLUB
description: Archival modem handshake waveforms, error 404 stamps, and vintage Japanese forum aesthetic.
storyQuote: When the web was quiet, mysterious, and full of secret doors.

name: LOADING...
description: Minimal chest progress bar [99%] with full back blueprint of vintage handheld gaming hardware.
storyQuote: Patience was part of the magic.

name: 1999.EXE
description: Retro system dialog windows, millennium bug aesthetics, and original pixel anime heroine artwork.
storyQuote: The future arrived, but we kept the soundtrack.

name: RONIN
description: Aki’s signature masterwork. Hand-drawn sumi-e ink strokes depicting the lone warrior under cherry blossom rain with Japanese kanji calligraphy.
storyQuote: A blade doesn’t seek blood. It seeks balance between chaos and stillness.

name: BROKEN BLADE
print: High-Density Screen Print with Red Foil Thread
description: A fractured obsidian katana bound together by red ancestral thread. Monochromatic minimalism with deep cultural storytelling.
storyQuote: Honor isn’t in an unbroken weapon. It is in the hands that keep fighting.

name: MOON WARRIOR
print: Discharge Screen Print for Zero-Hand Feel
description: Giant silver full moon setting behind ancient Shinto mountain gates with subtle mountain silhouette layers.
storyQuote: The moon watches a thousand wars, but remains peaceful.

name: ONI CODE
print: Puff Ink Mask Relief with Crimson Screen Accents
description: An original modern reimagining of the mythic Oni demon mask with geometric angles and distressed kanji crests.
storyQuote: Wear the mask to frighten off what lurks in the fog.

name: LAST SAMURAI
description: A striking minimalist back piece capturing the disciplined stance of the warrior facing incoming winds.
storyQuote: Not the final warrior in history, but the one who will not yield.

name: RED MOON
description: A massive vermilion blood moon disc framing an ancestral ronin crest on 240 GSM combed cotton.
storyQuote: When the moon turns red, history holds its breath.

name: TORI 001
description: The definitive Toriwear flagship garment. Micro chest brand coordinates with a high-fashion editorial manga composition on the reverse.
storyQuote: Chapter One of an original universe with no boundaries.

name: UNKNOWN
description: Redacted faction typography and minimal geometric coordinates. Designed for high fashion versatility beyond anime fandom.
storyQuote: No labels. No factions. Pure original identity.

name: OFFLINE
description: Clean monochrome chest emblem and a minimalist disconnected cable graphic with Japanese characters reading "Zero Transmission".
storyQuote: Disconnect from their noise to connect with your world.

name: NO SIGNAL
description: Static television noise bar across the upper chest with tonal back typography documenting fictional broadcast frequency 88.4 MHz.
storyQuote: Silence is sometimes the loudest frequency.

name: AFTER HOURS
description: Late night convenience store glow and rain drops captured in a vertical manga frame on the spine.
storyQuote: The best ideas arrive when everyone else has gone to sleep.

name: URBAN SOUL
description: Heavyweight boxy cut with subtle tonal crest on the hem and bold architectural typography framing the shoulders.
storyQuote: Built from imagination. Worn in the streets.

name: LITTLE DRAGON
description: A friendly baby dragon with tiny golden wings ready to fly! Soft 180 GSM bio-washed combed cotton, skin-friendly and breathable for all-day play.
storyQuote: Every giant legend starts with a tiny spark of courage.

name: FOREST HERO
description: A cute little woodland scout with an acorn cap and leaf companion exploring magical nature paths.
storyQuote: The grandest forest welcomes the smallest boots.

name: TINY NINJA
description: A super-cute chibi ninja peeking out from behind a lucky bamboo stalk with sparkling eyes.
storyQuote: Quick as a bunny, quiet as a falling leaf!

name: CLOUD RIDER
description: Gliding high on a smiling pink cloud with candy-colored stars raining down in soft pastel tones.
storyQuote: Ride the clouds where dreams are born.

name: STAR EXPLORER
description: Catching falling stars in a glowing adventure jar under friendly crescent moonbeams.
storyQuote: Look up at the night sky — the stars are waving at you!

name: ROBO BUDDY
description: Zero the mini robot friend offering a cheerful digital high-five with battery gauge full of happiness!
storyQuote: Beep boop! Best friends make every day fully charged!

name: SPACE CADET
description: Chibi space cadet floating past colorful ringed planets with friendly alien space jellyfish.
storyQuote: 3... 2... 1... Blast off into a universe of fun!

name: MECHA FRIEND
print: Soft Ink Print with Metallic Details
description: A gentle giant robot carrying flowers and smiling with bright glowing friendly eyes.
storyQuote: The strongest engines are built on the kindest hearts.

name: GALAXY RUNNER
description: Speeding through stardust tracks on cosmic rocket roller-skates with glowing rainbow trails.
storyQuote: Zoom past the satellites and catch the comet!

name: FUTURE KID
description: Wearing futuristic colorful goggles with hologram badges declaring "Future Inventor 2035".
storyQuote: Tomorrow belongs to the kids who build it today.

name: PLAYER KID
description: Charming pixel character holding a gold controller with 3 extra hearts floating above his head.
storyQuote: Ready Player One! Press Start to save the day!

name: LEVEL UP
description: Big sparkling gold "LEVEL UP!" trophy badge with jumping cartoon star power-ups.
storyQuote: Every year older is a whole new level unlocked!

name: PIXEL HERO
description: Chibi 8-bit knight holding a wooden training shield with cartoon dragon mascot friend.
storyQuote: Big courage inside a pixelated hero!

name: POWER MODE
description: Rainbow power star with energetic lightning bolt sparks and friendly arcade lettering.
storyQuote: Activate supreme power: Kindness and giggles!

name: GAME ON
description: Colorful handheld console with cartoon buttons and a smiling game screen avatar.
storyQuote: Adventure awaits at the push of a green button.

name: LITTLE RONIN
description: A charming child-safe little warrior holding a practice bamboo stick with cute floating cherry blossoms.
storyQuote: True warriors always share their snacks with friends!

name: MINI NINJA
description: Chibi ninja doing a joyful acrobat flip over a cartoon mountain stream with lucky koi fish.
storyQuote: Jump high, dream big, and giggle even louder!

name: DRAGON APPRENTICE
description: A young student balancing a friendly baby dragon on his shoulder while practicing balance on river stepping stones.
storyQuote: Friendship is the greatest secret scroll ever written.

name: TINY SAMURAI
description: Cute stylized ceremonial helmet with soft ribbon tassels and cheerful smiling warrior face.
storyQuote: The smallest hero can protect the grandest dream.

name: MOON DRAGON
description: A magical glittering baby dragon curled up fast asleep on a silver crescent moon with dreamy star clouds.
storyQuote: Sleep tight, little dreamer — the moon is guarding your castle.

name: STAR FOX
description: A magical celestial two-tailed fox kit with glowing starlight paws and a friendly happy expression.
storyQuote: Follow the star fox to where the northern lights dance!

name: CLOUD MONSTER
description: A fluffy, round, marshmallow-soft cloud monster eating sweet pink cotton candy with a huge smile.
storyQuote: The only monsters in our universe are cuddly and hungry for cookies!

name: MAGIC CREW
description: A delightful gathering of forest spirits, tiny dragons, and mechanical companion pets having a tea party.
storyQuote: Everyone has a seat at the magical picnic table.

name: LITTLE LEGENDS
description: A whimsical parade of mythical friends marching with rainbow banners toward a candy-mountain castle.
storyQuote: Step into the story and write your own chapter!
